name: Peema Aether-Seer
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, you get an amount of {E} (energy counters) equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
Pay {E}{E}{E}: Target creature blocks this turn if able.
blocked_sentences: Pay {E}{E}{E}: Target creature blocks this turn if able.

needs.what: a one-shot op placing an until-end-of-turn requirement on a target creature that it block (any attacker of its controller's choice) in every combat this turn if able -- no specific attacker named
needs.why_existing_wont_do: must_block always names the attacker to block (defaulting to the ability's source, i.e. provoke/lure-this-creature) and is spent after one combat by finish_blockers; using it would force the target to block Peema specifically and only in the next combat. attacks_if_able / must_attack are the attack-side mirror only, and no static or op expresses a generic block requirement
